# Bitify Music
> One seamless music experience across desktop, mobile and TV.

Bitify Music is a cross-platform music player built around a single library
that follows you across screens. It ships as a Windows desktop app, an Android
app and a TV app, with synced lyrics, playlists, listening stats, search and
full-screen album artwork.

## Key facts
- Official site: https://bitifyy.vercel.app
- Platform: cross-platform — Windows desktop, Android (ARM64), TV
- Desktop download: Windows x64 portable zip (v2.0.1), no installation needed
- Android download: ARM64 APK (v1.8.0)
- TV app: presented on the site; download link coming soon
- Canonical page: https://bitifyy.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://bitifyy.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Structured data: WebSite, Organization, SoftwareApplication and FAQPage JSON-LD on the homepage
